notes: The PDF is image-only (no text layer); all evidence quotes were transcribed from the rendered page images and should be spot-checked. source_page values are printed page numbers (= PDF page numbers in this file).
Seoul campus, 부모 모두 외국인인 외국인전형 학부 신입. Transfer (편입) items in the same table are not recorded.

Korean standard (p.16): TOPIK / TOPIK IBT 4급 이상 or 한양대학교 국제교육원 4급 수료 이상 is the standard to START the degree, not an admission condition ('한국어 기준 충족 여부와 관계없이 수학능력을 기반으로 학위과정 합격 결과가 정해집니다'); admitted students not meeting it take leave of absence to study Korean. Exempt: 학부 영어과정 지원자. Therefore not encoded as language_rules. TOPIK trial-test scores not accepted (p.06).
Korean score / Korean-language certificate and other activity evidence (기타활동증빙자료) are submitted only by holders ('소지자에 한함') - optional (p.12).

Translation (p.13): documents not in Korean or English must be submitted as Korean (English) notarized translations in principle. Other documents (awards, certificates) need Korean (English) translation originals.
Notarization validity (p.13): notarizations valid 6 months (issued on/after 2026-03-01); apostille and consular-confirmed documents have no validity limit.

Failure to submit consular/apostille originals within the application period is at the applicant's risk (p.13). All documents A4, in the order of the document list, by post; documents are not returned (p.13).
Country examples of family-relation documents are listed on p.13 (e.g. Vietnam: 출생증명서 (Giay khai sinh), Pakistan: Nadra Family Registration Certificate(FRC)).
Chinese 5-year integrated programmes ('중국 5년 일관제') are not eligible for the Seoul campus; Provisional/Temporary Certificates are not accepted as graduation documents (p.10).
English-track programme 국제학부 holds an English interview (p.09).
